_meta.description: Named phylogenetic clades used by MetaAves. Clades are not forced into Linnaean rank fields.

sources.name: Wikipedia — List of birds
sources.note: Audited current intermediate-rank groupings; the page cites IOC material and Stiller et al. 2024.

_meta.uncertaintyPolicy: Ranked AviList taxonomy remains authoritative. Named phylogenetic clades are an enrichment layer. Passerine intermediate groups are included where family-level placement is documented; uncertain deep relationships are not invented.
_meta.intermediateRankPolicy: AviList remains authoritative for order/family/genus/species. Intermediate named groups are enrichment data; only groups supported by the current source lineage and mapped to current MetaAves families are included.

clade:Palaeognathae.name: Palaeognathae
clade:Palaeognathae.description: Living birds traditionally comprising ratites and tinamous.

clade:Galloanserae.name: Galloanserae
clade:Galloanserae.description: Major clade containing Anseriformes and Galliformes.

clade:Neoaves.name: Neoaves
clade:Neoaves.description: Large clade containing most living bird species.

clade:Telluraves.name: Telluraves
clade:Telluraves.description: Core landbird clade containing Afroaves and Australaves.

clade:Afroaves.name: Afroaves
clade:Afroaves.description: A major Telluraves lineage including groups such as Accipitriformes, Strigiformes, Coliiformes and several cavity-nesting bird lineages. Deep relationships within Afroaves remain an active phylogenetic research topic.

clade:Australaves.name: Australaves
clade:Australaves.description: A major Telluraves lineage containing Cariamiformes, Falconiformes, Psittaciformes and Passeriformes.

clade:Psittacopasserae.name: Psittacopasserae
clade:Psittacopasserae.description: Clade containing parrots and passerines, nested within Eufalconimorphae.

clade:Aequornithes.name: Aequornithes
clade:Aequornithes.note: Placed under Phaethoquornithes in the selected Elementaves backbone; includes Gaviiformes, Sphenisciformes, Procellariiformes, Ciconiiformes, Suliformes and Pelecaniformes.

clade:Mirandornithes.name: Mirandornithes
clade:Mirandornithes.note: Flamingos and grebes; placement among major Neoaves lineages is kept separate from the simplified backbone.

clade:Columbimorphae.name: Columbimorphae
clade:Columbimorphae.note: Placed under Columbaves in the selected backbone; includes Columbiformes, Pterocliformes and Mesitornithiformes.

clade:Otidimorphae.name: Otidimorphae
clade:Otidimorphae.note: Placed under Columbaves in the selected backbone; includes Cuculiformes, Musophagiformes and Otidiformes.

clade:Strisores.name: Strisores
clade:Strisores.note: Placed under Elementaves in the selected backbone; includes hummingbirds, swifts and several nocturnal bird lineages.

clade:Phaethontimorphae.name: Phaethontimorphae
clade:Phaethontimorphae.note: Also historically called Eurypygimorphae; MetaAves uses Phaethontimorphae as the current backbone name.
clade:Phaethontimorphae.description: Clade containing Phaethontiformes (tropicbirds) and Eurypygiformes (sunbittern and kagu), supported by modern phylogenomic studies.

clade:Elementaves.name: Elementaves
clade:Elementaves.description: Major Neoaves clade in the Stiller et al. 2024 topology.

clade:Cursorimorphae.name: Cursorimorphae
clade:Cursorimorphae.description: Clade containing the crane/rail and shorebird lineages in the Stiller et al. 2024 topology.

clade:Opisthocomiformes.name: Opisthocomiformes
clade:Opisthocomiformes.description: Named clade/order containing the hoatzin lineage.

clade:Hieraves.name: Hieraves
clade:Hieraves.description: Clade of owls and accipitriform birds in the Stiller et al. 2024 Telluraves topology.

clade:Eufalconimorphae.name: Eufalconimorphae
clade:Eufalconimorphae.description: Clade containing falcons, parrots and passerines.

clade:Acanthisitti.name: Acanthisitti
clade:Acanthisitti.description: Ancient passerine lineage containing the New Zealand wrens.

clade:Eupasseres.name: Eupasseres
clade:Eupasseres.description: Clade containing all passerines except Acanthisittidae.

clade:Eurylaimides.name: Eurylaimides
clade:Eurylaimides.description: Infraorder containing Old World suboscines and the sapayoa.

clade:Tyrannides.name: Tyrannides
clade:Tyrannides.description: Infraorder containing the New World suboscines.

clade:Furnariida.name: Furnariida
clade:Furnariida.description: Parvorder containing the furnariid radiation of New World suboscines.

clade:Tyrannida.name: Tyrannida
clade:Tyrannida.description: Parvorder containing manakins, cotingas, tityras and tyrant flycatchers.

clade:Passerides.name: Passerides
clade:Passerides.description: Infraorder containing major songbird radiations including Passerida.

clade:Passerida.name: Passerida
clade:Passerida.description: Parvorder containing many of the familiar sparrows, finches, tanagers and related songbirds.

clade:Feraequornithes.name: Feraequornithes
clade:Feraequornithes.description: Aequornithes clade comprising Procellariiformes, Sphenisciformes, Ciconiiformes, Suliformes and Pelecaniformes.

clade:Pelecanimorphae.name: Pelecanimorphae
clade:Pelecanimorphae.description: Clade containing Ciconiiformes and the Pelecanes lineage.

clade:Craci.name: Craci
clade:Craci.description: Galliform suborder containing guans, chachalacas and curassows.

clade:Phasiani.name: Phasiani
clade:Phasiani.description: Galliform suborder containing guineafowl, New World quail and pheasants.

clade:Phasianoidea.name: Phasianoidea
clade:Phasianoidea.description: Superfamily containing New World quail and pheasants.

clade:Grui.name: Grui
clade:Grui.description: Gruiform suborder containing cranes and allies.

clade:Ralli.name: Ralli
clade:Ralli.description: Gruiform suborder containing rails and allies.

clade:Chionida.name: Chionida
clade:Chionida.description: Infraorder containing thick-knees, sheathbills and Magellanic plover.

clade:Charadriida.name: Charadriida
clade:Charadriida.description: Infraorder containing plovers and related shorebirds.

clade:Scolopaci.name: Scolopaci
clade:Scolopaci.description: Charadriiform suborder containing sandpipers and related lineages.

clade:Jacanida.name: Jacanida
clade:Jacanida.description: Infraorder containing jacanas and related lineages.

clade:Lari.name: Lari
clade:Lari.description: Charadriiform suborder containing gulls and allies.

clade:Turnicida.name: Turnicida
clade:Turnicida.description: Legacy compatibility alias. New data uses the documented suborder Turnici.

clade:Larida.name: Larida
clade:Larida.description: Infraorder containing coursers, crab-plover, skuas, auks and gulls.

clade:Sulae.name: Sulae
clade:Sulae.description: Suliform suborder containing boobies, darters and cormorants.

clade:Threskiornithes.name: Threskiornithes
clade:Threskiornithes.description: Pelecaniform suborder containing ibises and spoonbills.

clade:Pelecani.name: Pelecani
clade:Pelecani.description: Pelecaniform suborder containing hamerkop, shoebill and pelicans.

clade:Ardeae.name: Ardeae
clade:Ardeae.description: Pelecaniform suborder containing herons and relatives.

clade:Accipitres.name: Accipitres
clade:Accipitres.description: Accipitriform suborder containing the secretarybird, osprey and accipitrids.

clade:Upupoidea.name: Upupoidea
clade:Upupoidea.description: Superfamily containing hoopoes and wood hoopoes.

clade:Coracii.name: Coracii
clade:Coracii.description: Coraciiform suborder containing rollers and ground rollers.

clade:Alcedines.name: Alcedines
clade:Alcedines.description: Coraciiform suborder containing todies, motmots and kingfishers.

clade:Galbuli.name: Galbuli
clade:Galbuli.description: Piciform suborder containing jacamars and puffbirds.

clade:Pici.name: Pici
clade:Pici.description: Piciform suborder containing barbets, toucans, honeyguides and woodpeckers.

clade:Psittacoidea.name: Psittacoidea
clade:Psittacoidea.description: Parrot superfamily containing Psittacidae and Psittaculidae.

clade:Cinclosomatoidea.name: Cinclosomatoidea
clade:Cinclosomatoidea.description: Corvides superfamily containing jewel-babblers and quail-thrushes.

clade:Campephagoidea.name: Campephagoidea
clade:Campephagoidea.description: Corvides superfamily containing cuckooshrikes and trillers.

clade:Petroicida.name: Petroicida
clade:Petroicida.description: Passerides parvorder containing Australasian robins and related families.

clade:Eupetida.name: Eupetida
clade:Eupetida.description: Passerides parvorder containing rockfowl, rock-jumpers and rail-babbler.

clade:Paroidea.name: Paroidea
clade:Paroidea.description: Sylviida superfamily containing fairy warblers, hyliotas, penduline tits and true tits.

clade:Alaudoidea.name: Alaudoidea
clade:Alaudoidea.description: Sylviida superfamily containing nicators, bearded reedling and larks.

clade:Anseres.name: Anseres
clade:Anseres.description: Anseriform suborder containing the magpie goose and Anatidae.

clade:Apodi.name: Apodi
clade:Apodi.description: Apodiform suborder containing treeswifts and swifts.

clade:Thinocori.name: Thinocori
clade:Thinocori.description: Charadriiform suborder containing jacanas, painted-snipes, the plains-wanderer and seedsnipes.
